evidence.quote:
The submitted article can be indexed as is, both structurally and substantively. However,
concerning the DES, I would like to make a suggestion. Some of the countries that do not appear
in the database are democracies nowadays. It seems to me that following the evolution of their




electoral rules would contribute to a better understanding of the processes of democratization.
Thus, if DES can be supplemented with more European countries although if not defined as
democratic in the examined period, it will have a greater contribution to the comparative politics.

Dr. Daniela Pastarmadzhieva suggested to extend the DES 1919-1945 to countries which are
democracies today but have not been democracies during the interwar period.
Response: We agree with Dr. Daniela Pastarmadzhieva that this would be interesting and
relevant. Unfortunately, we do not have the resources and time to extend the DES as of now
but will keep this suggestion in mind for future extensions.
